answer: A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 85 aliases means authoring 85 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the crystal signature, the yarrow gate rejects a mismatch, and the sparrow checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 81 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
